description: Defines the image schema and methods to read and manipulate images within Apache Spark MLlib, including image decoding and metadata extraction.

methods.name: getOrigin
methods.description: Retrieves the origin string of the image from a Row.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Retrieves the height of the image from a Row.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Retrieves the width of the image from a Row.

methods.name: getNChannels
methods.description: Retrieves the number of channels in the image from a Row.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Retrieves the OpenCV mode integer from a Row.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves the image byte array from a Row.

methods.name: invalidImageRow
methods.description: Creates a default Row for an invalid image with placeholder values.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes compressed image bytes into an OpenCV-compatible Row with image data and metadata.
